verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm an official llms.txt at meilisearch.com, which the vendor says is maintained to help AI assistants. Docs pages are also served as markdown (.md), and each points agents to a full documentation index at /docs/llms.txt. Many cited doc URLs are .md variants, which corroborates agent-friendly docs across the site. Missing for 10: no evidence of a single-file full-docs dump (e.g. llms-full.txt) and no independent or community report of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.
